name: RmlUi
modifications: VeroScript Unicode bidirectional text integration: optional paragraph, line-run and visual-caret APIs; default font engines retain the legacy path.
Preserve normalized logical paragraph ranges through inline layout, soft wrapping, styled fragments and ellipsis; reorder visual fragments and inline decoration boxes per line.
Keep editable text in logical order while using full-line shaping for selection, visual cursor navigation, hit testing and IME placement; retain selection affinity across rebuilds.
Recognize UTF-8 line/paragraph separators and CRLF in the advanced text layout path without changing the existing ASCII whitespace-collapse behavior.
